moves.competitorObservation: Harvest and Mill launched bundled packages combining Women's Organic Jogger Pants with Unisex Style Tees in both Black and Natural colorways on January 28, 2026.
moves.suggestion: Create a comparable bundle for your customers by pairing your core tees with complementary bottoms. for example, a 'Colorful Essentials Bundle' combining one of your signature tees with coordinating pants or shorts in your most popular colorways.

moves.competitorObservation: Blue Canoe launched multiple textured basics including Pointelle and Baby Rib styles across tops, bottoms, and dresses in August 2026.
moves.suggestion: Expand your own textured basics collection by introducing new knit variations. such as ribbed or pointelle finishes. across your existing product categories to offer more tactile variety alongside your current offerings.

moves.competitorObservation: Blue Canoe is running ads highlighting their organic bra line's heritage, emphasizing 100% natural fiber organic cotton and breast-healthy design since 1994.
moves.suggestion: Strengthen your messaging around the organic and sustainable benefits of your apparel by emphasizing your own brand story and the quality materials you use. whether that's heritage, certifications, or your manufacturing standards. to build customer trust and differentiation.
